scope: Synthetic inputs only; no participant video and no detector inference

tests.name: Low-disk-space degradation
tests.detail: Event-video creation was disabled while the monitoring path remained callable.

tests.name: Camera disconnect and recovery
tests.detail: Two failed reads triggered reopen; a frame from the replacement capture was delivered.

tests.name: Video timestamp fallback
tests.detail: Non-increasing/negative timestamps resolved to monotonic frame-time values [0.0, 0.1, 0.2].

tests.name: Weight class-order startup rejection
tests.detail: A deliberately reordered phone model class map raised RuntimeError before monitoring began.

tests.name: Manifest failure-state retention
tests.detail: Both latest and timestamped manifests retained failed status, exception, and finish time.

tests.name: Event-buffer pre/post duration
tests.detail: At 10 FPS the clip retained frames 10-40: 1.0 s pre-trigger plus 2.0 s post-trigger.
